evidence: Static authorship comparison supports row 53. Frozen task/instruction.md:1-7 asks for JavaScript/complete-HTML execution, editor-preview-console, preservation of the actual interactive last-good picture, and shared saved history. task/task.toml:5-15 consistently identifies Colderwater, code-playground/devtools, execution isolation/recovery and multi-editor revision safety, with explicit adaptation provenance. environment/instructions/behaviour.md:7-15 and :34-40 define product-specific execution lifecycle, immutable three-field history, append-only restore, lost-reply retry and Save/restore races; security.md:3-9 separates snippet isolation/network limits from app assets. These are reflected in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:28 (filename execution dispatch), :168 (latest changed preview rollback), :504-532 (snapshot/inspection/restore/retry), and :560-581 (races and restart). Nearest sibling PatchPad is a long-report editor with word/grapheme navigation, multi-caret and grouped undo (projects/patchpad-editor-v3/environment/assets/instructions/editing.md:3-52), and restores an older revision as an UNSAVED undoable editor action (persistence.md:11-15); Colderwater restores to a NEW saved revision. GridForge instead owns cells, relative-reference fill, dependency calculation and collaboration presence (projects/gridforge-spreadsheet-v3/environment/assets/instructions/spreadsheet.md:3-41; collaboration.md:3-29). Boardloom is an authenticated per-user infinite canvas; Ridgeline is inventory/checkout. Shared persistence/concurrency patterns therefore do not make the playground a nouns-swapped sibling. NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:195-203 explicitly permits reusable infrastructure while requiring distinct domain behavior; this developer-tool concept fits that suite guidance. The frozen template contains CHANGE_ME product fields, which this candidate meaningfully replaces. Raw-index artifact hashes all match, but no configured judge, model, or portal result is inferred; those measurements are unnecessary for this source-authorship finding.
counterexample: Considered a renamed PatchPad with a Run button and static preview: its document editing/history could look plausible, but cannot satisfy the newly authored marker execution gate or the filename dispatch, cancelled callback, actual-picture recovery and code isolation outcomes. Considered a conforming frontend using different editor components or stacked panes: policy.md:5, integration.md:3 and ui.md:3/7 permit those choices, so metadata technology tags do not establish a clone or require one visual implementation.
